b97d00b6-2fab-435d-ae74-3233dcc13698.description: toList LIFO -> Empty linked list to list is empty
b97d00b6-2fab-435d-ae74-3233dcc13698.comment: Unsupported behavior: The Go track defines Array() in FIFO order (toList FIFO, reversing values() with slices.Reverse), which is mutually exclusive with toList LIFO. The empty list case is tested by enabled FIFO case 03fc83a5-48a8-470b-a2d2-a286c5e8365f ('toList FIFO -> Empty linked list to list is empty').

eedeb95f-b5cf-431d-8ad6-5854ba6b251c.description: toList LIFO -> To list with multiple values
eedeb95f-b5cf-431d-8ad6-5854ba6b251c.comment: Unsupported behavior: toList LIFO expects [3, 2, 1] for initialValues [1, 2, 3], but Go's Array() operation returns []int in FIFO order [1, 2, 3] via slices.Reverse(list.values()). Go does not support LIFO output on Array(); multiple-value conversion is tested by enabled FIFO case 1282484e-a58c-426a-972e-90746bda61fc ('toList FIFO -> To list with multiple values').
